name: FreeRTOS-Plus-TCP RA OOB Write
summary: Unsanitized prefix length in IPv6 Router Advertisement processing enables OOB write (GHSA-97qg-4359-xm3x). Adjacent attacker via rogue RA.

name: FreeRTOS-Plus-TCP RA OOB Read
summary: OOB read in RA option parser (GHSA-gffr-xgjg-jh9j).

name: FreeRTOS-Plus-TCP DHCPv6 Integer Underflow
summary: Integer underflow in DHCPv6 sub-option parser (GHSA-wrhm-c99p-2p8g).

name: FreeRTOS-Plus-TCP ICMP Echo Underflow
summary: Integer underflow in ICMP/ICMPv6 echo reply processing can DoS with MPU (GHSA-7r59-2pgv-9v2r).

name: FreeRTOS-Plus-TCP MAC Validation Bypass
summary: MAC address validation bypass in IPv4/IPv6 packet processing (GHSA-jpw4-6h59-62w9).

name: FreeRTOS-Plus-TCP LLMNR/mDNS OOB Write
summary: OOB write when processing very long LLMNR/mDNS names with Buffer Allocation Scheme 1 (GHSA-5x4f-fvv8-wr65).

name: FreeRTOS-Plus-TCP DNS Buffer Over-Read
summary: Critical buffer over-read in DNS response parser (GHSA-ppcp-rg65-58mv).

name: FreeRTOS-Plus-TCP IPv6/UDP Pointer Issues 2025
summary: Invalid pointer deref / buffer over-reads on malformed IPv6, UDP/IPv6, ICMPv6 packets.

name: Zephyr USB DFU Heap Overflow (memory readout)
summary: Heap buffer overflow in Zephyr USB DFU DNLOAD enabling large memory readout; PoC repo available.

name: Zephyr Bluetooth L2CAP Stack Overflow
summary: L2CAP le_ecred_conn_req stack overflow / info leak; part of CyRC Zephyr BLE advisory set.

name: Zephyr Bluetooth Subsystem Buffer Overflows
summary: Potential buffer overflows in Zephyr Bluetooth subsystem through 3.4.0 (GHSA-rgx6-3w4j-gf5j).

name: ThreadX Kernel Object Masquerading (KOM)
summary: Syscall parameter sanitization optimization enables KOM attacks on ThreadX; FreeRTOS noted lacking essential protections in same study.

name: RTCON-discovered RTOS kernel bugs (Zephyr/RIOT/FreeRTOS/ThreadX)
summary: RTCon reported 27 bugs (25 new) across Zephyr(14)/RIOT(8)/FreeRTOS(1)/ThreadX(4) with 14 CVEs assigned; many remotely reachable via packets.

name: FreeRTOS-MPU / RIOT MPU Bypass Case Studies
summary: NDSS BAR study shows MPU features can be circumvented; concrete attacks on FreeRTOS-MPU and RIOT.
